name: Standard Engineering Technology Limited
summary: Standard Engineering Technology Limited operates as an engineering equipment manufacturer in India and internationally. It operates through three segments: Glass Line Equipment; Metal Equipment and Pumps; and PTFE Lined Equipment. The company offers glass-lined reactors, receivers, rotary cone vacuum dryers, heat exchangers, storage tanks, valves, pipework, flanges, and fittings; and accessories, including solvent recovery systems, powder transfer system, automatic sampler system pressurized, automatic sample system atmospheric, multi purpose baffle, thermowell dip pipe, smart seal, and stanbalancer.
